zh.text: 「创建模组」的预设回到两个：「Blank Skeleton」与「Welcome Broadcast (Example)」。上一版多加的第三个预设「Source Patch via Bus」删掉 —— 两个预设生成的 loader.js 本来就是新机制（注入总线 + `SOURCE_PATCH` 开关），再多一个案例只是重复。要改服务端源码怎么写，仍然写在骨架里 `SOURCE_PATCH` 那一段注释上：填上 target / marker / slot / append 即走总线。

新增「静态数据」页：改完 _local/gameStore/data/<表>/data.json 不用重启服务端就能生效。服务端启动时把表读进内存、之后只读内存（gameStore/index.js:1208 `if (preloaded) return`），进程外写盘到不了那份内存，所以启动器在启动主服务器时用 NODE_OPTIONS=--require 注入 host（服务端源码零改动），由它在服务端进程内部用公开 API gameStore.write(table, "/", data) 整表覆盖内存副本，再清派生缓存，与模组注入总线互不干扰。生效方式按服务端源码如实分成三档，不是随手标：「即时」——表只经通用读缓存，重载后下次读取就是新值；「需重进场景」——还决定正在跑的星系里有什么，得等场景重建；「需重启服务端」——被某个没有重置入口的模块级索引冻住（例如 itemTypes / typeDogma / shipTypes / shipDogmaAttributes 被 itemTypeRegistry、liveFittingState 等 10 处模块冻着，worldData 又把 9 张地理表一次建图永不失效），这份清单来自扫 server/src 全量「模块级缓存 + 读静态表」模块的结果，共 25 张。服务端自己导出 clear*/reset*/refresh* 的表（mapTagsAuthority / missionAuthority / planetStaticData / dbuffCollections 等 17 个钩子）由 host 在重载时逐个调用，真正做成立即生效。界面给每张表补了中文名、分类与「谁把它冻住了」，重载结果里 `derivedRefreshed` 会逐个报出调过哪些钩子。这一页还给出可重载的静态表清单（本机实测 64 张；SQLITE_TABLES 里的运行时表一律拒绝，那份缓存就是活的世界状态）、脏表检测、重载选中 / 改动过的 / 全部、重载前自动快照与一键还原、失败与跳过原因。没通过启动器启动的主服务器会被识别出来并如实说明。

en.text: Create Mod is back to two presets: Blank Skeleton and Welcome Broadcast (Example). The third preset added last release, Source Patch via Bus, is removed: the loader.js both presets generate already uses the new mechanism (injection bus plus the SOURCE_PATCH switch), so a third example was pure duplication. How to patch server source is still documented in the SOURCE_PATCH comment block of the skeleton — fill in target / marker / slot / append and it goes through the bus.

New Static Data page: after editing _local/gameStore/data/<table>/data.json, the change takes effect without restarting the server. The server loads those tables into memory at startup and only reads that memory afterwards (gameStore/index.js:1208 `if (preloaded) return`), so an out-of-process write to disk never reaches it. The launcher therefore injects a host into the main server at startup through NODE_OPTIONS=--require (zero changes to the server source), and that host calls the public API gameStore.write(table, "/", data) inside the server process to overwrite the in-memory copy and then clears derived caches; it stays out of the way of the mod injection bus. How a table takes effect is reported honestly in three tiers derived from the server source rather than guessed: "Immediate" — the table is only read through the generic read cache, so the next read after a reload returns the new value; "Needs scene re-entry" — the table also decides what exists inside a running solar system, so it waits for the scene to be rebuilt; "Needs server restart" — the table is frozen by a module-level index with no reset entry point (for example itemTypes / typeDogma / shipTypes / shipDogmaAttributes are frozen by itemTypeRegistry, liveFittingState and eight other modules, and worldData builds nine geographic tables into its map once and never invalidates them). That list of 25 tables comes from scanning every module in server/src that caches a static table at module level. Tables for which the server itself exports clear*/reset*/refresh* (17 hooks such as mapTagsAuthority / missionAuthority / planetStaticData / dbuffCollections) are called one by one by the host during a reload, which is what actually makes them take effect immediately. The UI adds a Chinese name, a category and "who froze it" for every table, and the reload result now reports each hook it called in derivedRefreshed. The page also lists the reloadable static tables (64 measured on this machine; runtime tables listed in SQLITE_TABLES are always rejected because that cache is live world state), detects dirty tables, offers reload-selected / reload-changed / reload-all, takes an automatic snapshot before reloading with one-click restore, and explains every failure and skip. A main server that was not started by the launcher is detected and reported honestly.
